overall_summary: Data clearly shows that relationship dynamics, particularly husband-wife and family realities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए'), significantly outperform general heartbreak shayari or generic motivational shorts. Repeatable patterns point towards adult relationship realities and unspoken domestic pain points.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on husband-wife dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') achieved the highest views on the channel (1,770 and 1,679 views respectively).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage and long-term relationship emotional compromises rather than generic college or one-sided love.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as a direct question or a common realization ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') perform moderately well compared to abstract poetic statements.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational premises that target universal domestic or emotional guilt.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos relying purely on poetic or overly dramatic phrasing ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा') received very low traction (21 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract Urdu/Hindi poetic jargon; ground the emotional pain in everyday observable life.

weak_patterns.evidence: Re-uploading the exact same topic ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') within a short window caused a massive drop in views (from 122/139 down to 19).
weak_patterns.action: Maintain clear spacing between similar family topics and avoid repetitive phrasing.
